text:
alex: Heads-up — MaplePay wants a short POC to migrate from CloudPrompt. Main asks: API surface parity, pricing delta, and security questionnaire answers. Can we get a presales checklist?

mira: I can drive the POC. Need a small sample of their traffic (5–10 representative requests) + 1 failing case they blame on model differences.

simon: For infra: what are their peak qps and acceptable p95 latency? Also: do they rely on stateful sessions or one-off stateless requests?

alex: @mira they said ~120 qps burst, 40 sustained, p95100–200ms currently. Mostly stateless but a few endpoints use conversation_id header for session affinity.

mira: OK — plan: spin a dev dedicated pool with a compatible model variant, wire an API shim to translate CloudPrompt's /predict -> /v1/generate. I'll draft the mapping.

raquel: Security doc asks about data residency, KMS, and SOC2 controls. Do they need bring-your-own-key?

linh: Pricing: if they commit to 100k tokens/day we can offer 20% off hosted, or price Dedicated reserved pool. Need to know tokenization differences — CloudPrompt bills per character, they want a token-equivalent estimate.

mira: For mapping, here's a quick shim we use in POCs:
```
// pseudocode mapping CloudPrompt -> Redwood
POST /predict { prompt: string, convo_id?: string }
-> POST /v1/generate { input: prompt, session: convo_id }
```
Remember to translate stop sequences and max_tokens.

alex: Important ent blocker: legal flagged streaming behavior mismatch (CloudPrompt streams partial JSON chunks). They want identical chunking semantics for their UI. Can we reproduce stream chunk boundaries?

simon: We can approximate but exact byte-for-byte chunking is hard. Recommend: expose a small shim service that buffers and emits CloudPrompt-style events. That keeps runtime stable and avoids runtime hacks.

raquel: For the security questionnaire: I'll answer standard SOC2/KMS + will ask product for audit logs retention (they want 1 year) and EKM support. Also need an IP/data flow diagram.

linh: On billing estimate: ask them to run 1k of their representative requests through our tokenizer (we can provide a small script) and we'll return projected costs under hosted vs dedicated. Also highlight savings with prefix caching for repetitive prompts.

mira: POC checklist draft: 
- get 10 sample requests (include failing case)
- network allowlist for staging IPs (I'll send list)
- decide streaming shim vs native streaming
- tokenization sample + cost estimate script
- security Q answered + diagram
- SLA and fallback policy (canary to CloudPrompt)

alex: Can someone start answering the security questionnaire draft this week? Customer expects a response by EOD Friday.

raquel: I'll take it. Will loop in product for logs retention and EKM.

devops-bot: Reserved pool request created: rp-2101 (4 x A10g) — staging env will be ready ~36h.

mira: Thanks @devops-bot — once staging up I'll push the shim and a CI test that replays their 10 requests and diffs responses (allowing fuzzy match for templates).

alex: One more ask from sales: show a deterministic way to handle prompt-parity tweaks (tokenization and stop tokens). Can we produce a short doc/snippet we can share with MaplePay engineers?

mira: I'll write a 1-pager: token mapping, stop-token translation, and tips to preserve deterministic outputs (seeded sampling off / temperature low). Will attach to email to their eng lead.

linh: Price quick math: if 100k tokens/day -> ~3M/month, hosted list would be $X, with 20% discount = $Y. Dedicated committed saves roughly 30% more depending on model. I'll finalize numbers after token samples.

alex: Great. I'll coordinate customer expectations. Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks the Friday deliverables. :thumbsup:
